note: TruthPad 官方插件源（四个插件）。url 是 GitHub Release 资产的绝对地址；size/sha256 与包一一对应，客户端下载后会校验。

plugins.name: PDF 阅读器
plugins.author: TruthPad
plugins.description: PDF 阅读与批注（MuPDF 引擎；本插件以 AGPL-3.0 发布）：连续滚动、缩略图/书签/批注三标签左栏、文本选择与查找、高亮/下划线/删除线/便签批注并能保存回文件
plugins.descriptionEn: PDF reading and annotation (MuPDF engine; this plugin is released under AGPL-3.0): continuous scrolling, a three-tab sidebar (thumbnails / bookmarks / annotations), text selection and search, highlight/underline/strikethrough/sticky-note annotations saved back into the file.

plugins.name: 浏览器
plugins.author: TruthPad
plugins.description: 内嵌 WebView2 的轻量浏览器：前进 / 后退 / 刷新 / 地址栏。开发时用来在编辑器里看视频教程（YouTube / bilibili）。入口在标题栏右侧的按钮（插件菜单里也有一项）
plugins.descriptionEn: Lightweight embedded WebView2 browser: back / forward / reload / address bar. Handy for watching video tutorials (YouTube / bilibili) right inside the editor. Entry point is the button on the right of the title bar (also available in the plugin menu).

plugins.name: WSL 集成
plugins.author: TruthPad
plugins.description: 连接 WSL 发行版：wsl:// 远程目录与文件在编辑器内等价操作，项目文件里的 wsl 块可自动挂载
plugins.descriptionEn: Connect WSL distributions: wsl:// remote folders and files behave like local ones in the editor; the wsl block in project files mounts automatically.

plugins.name: 图片查看器
plugins.author: TruthPad
plugins.description: 在编辑区标签里查看图片：滚轮以光标为中心缩放、拖拽平移、双击适应/1:1、亮度/对比度/饱和度调色、裁剪、保存（覆盖/另存为）、←/→ 同目录翻页
plugins.descriptionEn: View images in an editor tab: wheel zooms around the cursor, drag pans, double-click fits/1:1, brightness/contrast/saturation adjustments, crop, save (overwrite / save as), ←/→ flips through the folder.
